subject: RFI: Control reconciliation & evidence handoff for SIG/SOC2/ISO
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@deltaconsortium.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@deltaconsortium.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Control reconciliation & evidence request

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this on. Delta Consortium is running a consolidated SIG/SOC2/ISO assessment for our central platform team and we need a control-level reconciliation plus representative artifacts for evidence review. Specifically we need: 

- An annotated SIG spreadsheet mapping each Delta control to Redwood controls (call out any gaps).
- A crosswalk document showing where SOC 2 and ISO clauses are covered by Redwood controls.
- Representative artifacts for a subset of controls (e.g., access logs, change approvals, vulnerability scan report metadata). We only need samples, not full production datasets.

Target timeline: initial deliverables by 2027-10-06 so our reviewers can start. Please call out anything that is out-of-scope, or requires an NDA/DPA before you can share artifacts.

Also: can you confirm whether you can place artifacts on our read-only SFTP or if you prefer a shared Drive folder?

Appreciate it — happy to set up a quick sync.

Best,
Anna Liu
Procurement Lead | Delta Consortium
anna.liu@deltaconsortium.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@deltaconsortium.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Control reconciliation & evidence request

Anna — thanks for the clear ask. We can meet the 2027-10-06 milestone with the following delivery plan:

1) By 2027-09-29: annotated SIG spreadsheet (redwood_SIG_mapping_v1.xlsx) with per-control owner, coverage notes, and gap flags.
2) By 2027-10-03: SOC2/ISO crosswalk (SOC2_ISO_crosswalk_annotated.pdf) with references to our policy, procedure, and technical controls.
3) By 2027-10-06: representative artifact bundle (sample logs, scan metadata, change ticket screenshots) delivered to a secure Drive folder or your SFTP — whichever you prefer. We will avoid PII in samples.

Two quick points:
- Some artifacts (e.g., full access logs covering customer requests) require a DPA addendum and a short intake (we will mark those items in the spreadsheet and tag them as "requires DPA").
- For on-prem/private deployment specifics, Karthik (copied) will add technical notes about boundaries and where our standard evidence differs from dedicated/private setups.

If that timeline looks good, can we schedule a 30-min sync on Fri 2027-09-24 at 10:00 AM PT to align scope and handoff details? I can also share a Drive folder link and a DocuSign packet for the DPA.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_mapping_v1.xlsx, SOC2_ISO_crosswalk_annotated.pdf

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@deltaconsortium.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 08:05:37 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Control reconciliation & evidence request

On Wed, Sep 22, 2027 at 11:40 AM, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Anna — thanks for the clear ask. We can meet the 2027-10-06 milestone with the following delivery plan:
> ...

Quick technical clarifications from my side so we scope the right artifacts:

- Data residency / scope: please confirm whether Delta needs evidence for our hosted API footprint only, or also for Dedicated/Private deployments. Some log sources differ when a customer runs Redwood Private (e.g., customer-managed KMS events).
- Log sampling: we will provide a sanitized CSV slice (timestamp, request_id, model_id, action, result_code). If you need full request body redaction examples, we will need to schedule a secure transfer and explicitly mark fields as "sensitive".
- Vulnerability artifacts: we can provide dashboard screenshots and truncated reports (no full CVE payloads).

If you can flag the scope (hosted only vs all deployment types) we will annotate the spreadsheet accordingly.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@deltaconsortium.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 10:02:05 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Control reconciliation & evidence request — handoff details

Thanks all — Rafael and Karthik, we will act as evidence owners for the items in scope. Anna, per our sync today (recap below):

- Scope confirmed: hosted API footprint only (Delta requested no Private/Dedicated artifacts).
- Delivery: we will place artifacts in a read-only Drive folder and share explicit links. For items that require the DPA (access to raw auth logs), we will send a DocuSign packet for your legal team to sign; artifacts marked "requires DPA" will only be posted after DocuSign completion.
- Deliverables and internal owners: 
  * Annotated SIG spreadsheet (redwood_SIG_mapping_v1.xlsx) — Rafael (AE) / Neha (owner of evidence mapping)
  * SOC2/ISO crosswalk PDF (SOC2_ISO_crosswalk_annotated.pdf) — Rafael / Security team
  * Representative artifacts (evidence_sample_logs_20270921.csv, vuln_scan_metadata_sample.json, change_approval_screenshot.png) — Neha / Karthik

We will avoid PII and customer-identifying tokens in samples. Attached: evidence_sample_logs_20270921.csv (sanitized sample). We will also include a README in the Drive folder documenting how each file maps to spreadsheet rows.

Next steps:
- I will share Drive link + DocuSign for DPA by EOD 2027-09-24.
- Rafael: please send the initial spreadsheet version now (attached).

Attachments: evidence_sample_logs_20270921.csv

Neha Kapoor
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@deltaconsortium.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@deltaconsortium.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Control reconciliation & evidence request

Thanks Rafael / Neha / Karthik — this plan works for us. We received the first spreadsheet and the sample CSV in the shared folder; we confirm scope = hosted API only.

Two quick asks:
- Can the sample CSV include a short header row with column descriptions (we saw timestamp, request_id, model_id, action, result_code but a header would make review faster)?
- For artifacts that require DPA, please flag them clearly in the spreadsheet (we will route DocuSign quickly).

I scheduled our internal reviewers to start on 2027-10-07 after your final bundle. If anything changes, I will loop you in.

Best,
Anna
